description.value: Banana Grove Market & Deli is a full-service neighbourhood grocery store in East Vancouver, offering fresh produce, a deli counter, and a dedicated meat department with weekly specials. The store operates seven days a week and stocks a broad range of pantry staples alongside fresh and prepared deli items. It serves as a solid resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the Renfrew-Collingwood area of Vancouver.

The site clearly describes a full grocery/deli/meat/produce operation, supporting Basic groceries as true.
